nodes.title: NOTES ON MASKS
widgets_values:
In the driving video, using animation mode, anything that is colored will either come through to the output as is OR the model will fill in that area based on what it thinks it should in the prompt.

If there is a person and dog, and the conditioning prompt is 'person, dog' in SAM3.

The mask (assuming max_objects high enough) should show both color shadows.

In the SCAIL prompt you can put "A person is walking their pet dragon, it has a scale tail and horns" and it will replace dog with dragon. Or you could say they are walking dog and the original dog should come through especially if you describe it

nodes.title: overall_soundscape - Important
subject_definition - Important
widgets_values:
The Input Text prompt is designed to be an 'omni' prompt which will just work in most cases.  However, if the model is not replacing well, you may need to add specific context to the Subject 1 description to help.

EXAMPLE:
subject is wearing a 'black and blue stripped tank top', add that to the description in the reference to: 

<Subject 1> is the person in <Picture 1> and <Picture 2>; <Picture 1> supplies facial features and close-up details, while <Picture 2> provides 3-panel image of front mid shot, profile mid shot, and front full body view, identity follows these reference assets, she is wearing a black and blue striped tank top, only appearance is retained.

ANOTHER CONCEPT:
the current 'omni' description uses outfit and clothing terms, this pushes the model to add clothing. if there is no clothing changes those words to nude or naked
